jobs.name: skill-inscrita-alma
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original landscape 3:2 conceptual painted illustration for Nihility, a modular tabletop RPG. A quiet ordinary adult traveler in a simple dark teal shirt is shown in three-quarter profile from waist up, hand resting on chest, eyes open in wonder. Adjacent to the body is an artistic translucent pale blue human-shaped silhouette representing the soul, not a holographic display. Within a softly indicated inner layer of that soul, show ONE compact astonishingly intricate interwoven circuit of fine branching copper-red paths, with distinct beginnings and closed connected paths, embedded in the layer rather than floating as sparkles. The person does not draw or assemble it; it is inscribed by the universe itself, with no separate deity, humanoid creator, giant hand, UI, cosmic face or portal. Calm matte background mostly warm off-white paper, very spare diffuse ink-blue star-field fading out at upper edge suggests the universe without spectacle. Expressive narrative acrylic and gouache painting, confident brushwork, restrained meaningful detail, natural human anatomy, no cyberpunk neon, glowing eyes, ornate gold filigree, purple gold color grading, random runes, text, logos, labels or numbers. This is a symbolic illustration of a magical circuit held in a layer of a soul, not scientific anatomy. Make the relationship between person, soul layer and circuit clearly readable at book size.
